item.isekai_mahou.rogue_dagger.flavor.0: Light, quick and easy to hide up a sleeve.
item.isekai_mahou.rogue_dagger.flavor.1: Cuts purse strings before the owner feels the tug.
item.isekai_mahou.rogue_dagger.flavor.2: It drinks the light around it: nobody sees the steel shine.
item.isekai_mahou.rogue_dagger.flavor.3: Every cut leaves a wound that will not close.
item.isekai_mahou.rogue_dagger.flavor.4: They say whoever wields it vanishes along with the last victim.
item.isekai_mahou.rogue_throwing_knife.d: Use: throw (4 damage). Rogues: double from behind and can crit. Drops to the ground to be picked up.
Blank pages that learn from other people's magic.

Use: cast the selected page (½ mana). Sneak + use: next page.
item.isekai_mahou.rogue_ledger.flavor: Every theft written down. Every debt collected.
item.isekai_mahou.rogue_ledger.use: Use: open the Rogue tab. Sneak + use: rank up (or show what is missing).
item.isekai_mahou.rogue_shade_t4_helmet: Phantom Thief's Top Hat and Mask

Stitched with shadow thread: silent even at a run.
The outfit every guard describes and none can find.
White as the calling card left where the treasure used to be.

Rogues: crits and double damage from behind.
Kill with it: you vanish for 2 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_shadow_step.des: Form: vanish and reappear BEHIND the aimed enemy (16 blocks), briefly invisible; effects land from behind. No target: an 8-block shadow leap.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_knife_fan.desc: Form: throws 3 spectral knives in a fan (Split +2, max 11); each knife carries the effects. Each knife is a copy (costs per knife).
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_stolen_page.des: Form: unleashes the selected page of the Stolen Grimoire (1 charge, ½ of the original mana). Effects placed after it hit the aimed enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_phantom_heist.d: G form (ultimate): become a shadow and hop from back to back of up to 6 enemies (Split +2), applying the effects from behind and robbing each one; return and leave the calling card.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_backstab.desc: Shadow damage. From behind (or distracted target, you invisible/in Ambush): ×2.5 and Bleeding.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_pickpocket.desc: Steals an item from the target (mob loot, NPC pocket, boss, player backpack with PvP). From behind: better odds. Robbing an NPC in sight is a crime.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_mana_siphon.des: Light damage and steals resource: 6% of a player's maximum comes to you; from creatures, drains 3% of your maximum (more from magical ones).
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_buff_theft.desc: Rips up to 2 beneficial effects off the target (+1 per Amplify) and puts them on you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_spell_theft.des: Copies the last spell the target cast (30 s) into the Stolen Grimoire, with 1 to 3 charges.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_vital_mark.desc: Marks the target for 10 s and Exposes it: your next hit/spell on it is a guaranteed ×2 crit. Killing a marked target refunds 10% resource.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_smoke_veil.desc: Beneficial: invisible for 3 s and your next hit counts as from behind; nearby enemies lose sight of you and are blinded.

message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.book.ca: Stolen page: «%s» — the last charge crumbled.

message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.heist.d: Phantom Thief's Heist: %s targets. Calling card left behind.
message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.rank.no: Only a Rogue understands the numbers in this book.
message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.rank.ma: You are already the King of Thieves.
message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.rank.up: New rank in the Thief's Ledger: %s! (+%s XP)
message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.rank.fl: "First the purse, then the pocket, then the whole house."
The shadows learned your name. Now you steal even what cannot be touched.
The Thieves' Guild whispers about you. Knives fly wherever you point.
No vault resists. No crowd sees you pass.
Tonight every treasure in the world already has an owner: you. Always leave the calling card.
message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.gear.wo: You are already wearing the new outfit (the old one went to your backpack).
message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.gear.in: The new pieces went to your backpack.
message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.welcome: The Rogue learned their tricks: Backstab, Shadow Step, Light Fingers and Smoke Veil are in the Grimoire.

screen.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.not_rogu: This tab belongs to the Rogue. Other classes only learn the tricks through Lessons.

screen.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.reward.5: +%s XP, Phantom Blade (dagger IV), the Legends Heist of the Century and The Plunderer's Secret, 4th Grimoire page, double pockets, copy ultimates.
message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.lurk: Lurking for %s s: monsters forget you.
message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.lurk_st: From the shadows: a strike from behind!
message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.lurk_br: You were noticed: the lurk is over.
message.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.godspee: Godspeed for %s s: your body turned to lightning.
legend.isekai_mahou.rogue_thousand_shado: Rhythm Echo: Dance of a Thousand Shadows
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_lurk.desc: Rogue EFFECT (Shadow, beneficial; homage to the thief skill of the unlucky adventurer from another world). You (or an ally) vanish for 15 s (Extend +): invisible and FORGOTTEN by monsters — anything not right next to you (2.5 blocks) drops its target and can't aim again. Attacking reveals you, and that attack counts as from behind; taking damage also reveals you. Bosses aren't fooled. Unlock: Ledger, rank I.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_drain_touch.des: Rogue EFFECT (Shadow; homage to the lich skill the unlucky adventurer learned). Your hand drains HEALTH and RESOURCE: 5 damage and you recover 60%% of the damage dealt as health. From a player, 4%% of THEIR max resource flows to you; from creatures, you gain 2.5%% of YOUR max (4%% from magical creatures). Unlock: Ledger, rank I.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_assassin_claw.d: Rogue EFFECT (Shadow, Circle 2; homage to the claw-hand of the elite assassin family). Your fingers become claws: 9 damage (×1.5 against bleeding targets) and 2 Bleeding. From behind, if the creature is left at 25%% health or less: RIP OUT THE HEART — instant death and you recover 15%% of your health. Bosses don't die this way; against players it becomes +40%% damage. Unlock: Ledger, rank II.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_rhythm_echo.des: Rogue FORM (Shadow, Circle 3; homage to the young assassin's rhythmic steps). You run around the aimed enemy (up to 14 blocks; Accelerate +3) in a rhythm that fools the eye: 3 afterimages that look like you (+1 per Split, up to 6) circle them while you vanish. The target is lost (monsters drop their target and slow down). After 1.2 s each image lunges and applies the effects at 40%% power, then you appear BEHIND them and apply the full effects (Backstab ×2.5!). With no target: the images become decoys around you. Cost: 1 + 0.4 copy per image. Unlock: Ledger, rank III.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_godspeed.desc: Rogue EFFECT (Lightning, Circle 5; homage to the electric body of the assassin family's heir). On yourself (Self) — WHIRLWIND: 10 s (Extend +) of electric body — Speed III, Jump II and Haste II; the first blow coming at you each second is DODGED by reflex (leaving an afterimage), you appear behind the attacker and counter with 6 lightning damage; your melee hits shock. On an enemy — THUNDER: a lightning bolt strikes the target (8 lightning damage), Shocked and Stunned for 1 s (bosses aren't stunned). Unlock: Ledger, rank IV.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_one_cut: Cursed Blade: One Cut, One Kill
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_one_cut.desc: Rogue EFFECT (Shadow, Circle 7; homage to the cursed imperial sword of the red-eyed assassin). A cut for 6 leaves a curse that climbs the body as black marks; in 3 s it reaches the heart: ordinary creatures DIE (cursed poison, no cure). Bosses lose 12%% of max health and players 30%% (up to 400, × power) and wither — against them no one dies instantly. Cutting again doesn't reset the countdown. Unlock: Ledger, rank V.
